title: Laplace Transform of the Unit Pulse Function in the Limit
expert_review: Crucial bridge between time-domain pulse approximations and the frequency-domain representation of the Dirac Delta function.
learning_objectives: Express the Laplace transform of a pulse function as an integral
Apply the sampling property of unit pulses to exponential functions
Determine the limit of a transform as the pulse width vanishes
Connect the mathematical limit to the property of the Dirac Delta function
